paragraphs: Friend, here's what I want you to hold onto. Jonah ran from God, and God came back to him anyway. Jonah 3:1 says, "Then the word of the LORD came to Jonah a second time." I know that feeling. I sat in the back of a junk drawer for YEARS, and the One who made everything still came and got me.

Now look at Nineveh. They hear one short message, and they believe God (Jonah 3:5). Then they act on it, from the greatest to the least, and the king comes down off his throne to sit in ashes (Jonah 3:6). The king says, "Let each one turn from his evil ways and from the violence in his hands." (Jonah 3:8) Believing God and turning go together, friend, like dough and heat.

The king doesn't know how God will answer. He says, "Who knows? God may turn and relent." (Jonah 3:9) Then God sees what they did, and He relents from the disaster He had threatened (Jonah 3:10). So when you've gotten it wrong, don't hide from God. Turn back to Him, because He is the God who comes back to you. And keep your oven warm, because this story is NOT done yet.
